verdict.rationale: Beamer is a changelog and in-app announcement SaaS, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair automation question for it, but the evidence pack never documents recurring schedules, scheduled workflows, or even one-off scheduled posts. The mention of an API and webhooks is only a developer building block, and 'regular' NPS feedback does not describe a configurable recurring schedule, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
